title: Rpg maker VX Ace How to show TP and MP in a skill that uses both

posts.author: FinnishEngineer
posts.body:
Is there a way to show tp and mp in one skill that uses both to cast?
When I do that it only shows tp.

posts.author: Timtrack
posts.body:
I think that with vanilla rpg maker you can't do this. Personally I use
Yanfly's Skill Cost Manager
which allows to display multiple costs for a single skill (you can also create fancier costs like hp, gold or % of mp).
